source.title: HST OPAL Cycle 33 Uranus 2025a F657N/F547M/F467M global map
source.credit: NASA / ESA / HST OPAL Team (PI Amy Simon) / STScI; adapted by Starward

processing: Starward took the RGB median across valid longitudes in each planetographic latitude row of the historical three-filter map, omitted rows with under 90% coverage, and resized the profile to 8x512 RGBA PNG. The missing-latitude mask uses nearest-neighbour resampling and binary alpha; hidden RGB is extended only to avoid interpolation fringes. This is an adaptation under CC BY 4.0.
limitations: Historical band colors from an enhanced, arbitrarily scaled three-filter composite, not natural color or live Uranus weather.
Longitude-dependent clouds were removed; no current feature longitude is claimed.
Transparent latitudes lack source atmosphere coverage and must fall back to the plain computed globe; the nominal global map does not measure the entire planet.
